name: Chomped! 🐊
desc:
🆕 UPDATE 9/30/26 🆕
👻 Ghost Mode: got chomped? Bet on who's next & curse a tooth!
🎲 New Modes: Double Trouble, Golden Tooth & Blackout
🔥 Win Streaks + new Win Streak leaderboard
💥 12 Chomp FX for when YOU get chomped
🦷 Teeth get pressed one by one... who's next?
🛠️ New map areas, start screen & tons of bug fixes

Welcome to Chomped! Face off in a circle of up to 12 players and pick a tooth from the crocodile's mouth. Choose the wrong tooth and get chomped! Be the last player standing to win!

🦷 Pick a tooth when your turn comes
🎮 Use power-ups to change the gameplay
💰 Earn coins by surviving rounds
😎 Unlock custom crocodile tooth skins
📊 Climb the leaderboard and track your stats
👥 Invite friends and see who survives the longest

Credits to @LordLongNose for making the map + crocodile mesh

❤️ LIKE the game for more crazy updates!

Inspired by: Pass or Die
